item.description: The Coast Guard rescued a fisherman who fell overboard near Mangaluru while pulling nets. He was retrieved safely but needed immediate medical care.

item.title: মা ও তিন বোন হত্যার কারণ জানতে চান স্বজন
item.description: মা ও তিন বোনকে কেন হত্যা করা হলো, তার আসল কারণ জানতে চেয়েছেন এক স্বজন। এই হত্যাকাбে অন্তর একা জড়িত ছিল নাকি অন্য কেউ যুক্ত ছিল, পুলিশ যেন তা নিরপেক্ষভাবে তদন্ত করে খুঁজে বের করে।

item.title: Congress calls to scrap Siang hydro project and free detainees
item.description: The Arunachal Pradesh Congress Committee demanded the cancellation of the Siang hydropower project and the release of detained protesters. It also appealed to local groups and institutions to unite against the initiative.

item.title: Berlin hosts government-backed digital summit on AI technology
item.description: Berlin is hosting an official conference to evaluate the benefits and risks of artificial intelligence. Meanwhile, defense chiefs from Germany and the UK plan to address AI integration in military defense.

item.title: Odisha evacuates residents as Cyclone Murasu intensifies
item.description: Following the strengthening of Cyclone Murasu in the Bay of Bengal, Odisha authorities began relocating residents from at-risk zones. Emergency response protocols have also been reinforced across the region.

item.title: কুমিল্লার বৃক্ষপ্রেমী হাসান ফিরোজ চার দশকে তৈরি করেছেন ৫০০ বনসাই
item.description: বনসাইয়ের সৌন্দর্য দেখে অনুপ্রাণিত হয়ে কুমিল্লার হাসান ফিরোজ নিজেই তা তৈরি করা শুরু করেন। দীর্ঘ ৪০ বছরেরও বেশি সময়ে তিনি প্রায় ৫০০ বনসাই তৈরি করেছেন।

item.title: SC Seeks Tamil Nadu's Response on Palani Land Fraud Bail Bid
item.description: The Supreme Court has asked the Tamil Nadu government to respond to K. Vellathurai's appeal against the rejection of his bail. Vellathurai is connected to the Palani math property fraud case, and the state has also submitted an intervention request.

item.title: Kharge Accuses Rival Camp of Deploying Federal Agencies in KPSC Probe
item.description: Priyank Kharge claims central bodies like the ED and I-T are being weaponized against Congress figures in Karnataka. This follows police discovery of a connection between a sting video probe and Union Minister H.D. Kumaraswamy's Delhi home.

item.title: সাতক্ষীরার ভাগ্যকুল মিষ্টান্ন ভান্ডারে উপচে পড়া ভিড়
item.description: ঈদের দিন সকাল থেকে রাত পর্যন্ত ক্রেতাদের ভিড়ে মুখর থাকে সাতক্ষীরার ঐতিহ্যবাহী এই মিষ্টির দোকান। প্রায় ৩৫ পদের মিষ্টির মধ্যে এখানকার দইয়ের চাহিদা সবচেয়ে বেশি।

item.title: Hungary to Disclose Identities of Communist-Era State Informants
item.description: Hungary's administration plans to publish the records of thousands of communist-period state spies active between 1945 and 1989. The disclosure aims to restore public trust by confronting historical secrets of surveillance and dissent suppression.

item.title: Chennai Metro Cuts Poonamallee-Vadapalani Commute to 30 Minutes
item.description: The 14.6-kilometer metro route now takes roughly half an hour during rush hours due to fewer station stops. Trains along this sector will exclusively service Valasaravakkam and Saligramam.

item.title: Audio Recordings Reveal Final Distress Messages from Learjet Crew
item.description: Freshly published air traffic communications document the desperate mayday signals transmitted by the pilot prior to a Learjet 60 accident.

item.title: India Factory Growth Moderates in October Amid Slower Demand
item.description: The HSBC India Manufacturing PMI dropped to 54.7 in October compared to 55.1 in September due to slower output expansion. Despite the decline, the index stays well past the 50-point threshold indicating continuous growth.

item.title: বরিশালের শতবর্ষী প্রাচীন ও ক্ষুদ্রাকৃতির গায়েবি মসজিদ
item.description: বরিশালের চরমোনাইয়ে অবস্থিত মাত্র ছয় ও পাঁচ ফুটের এই ছোট মসজিদে একত্রে তিনজনের বেশি নামাজ পড়া যায় না। শত বছরের পুরনো এই মসজিদটি ঘিরে নানা রহস্য ও লোকবিশ্বাস রয়েছে।

item.title: Congress criticizes central government over Delhi air pollution
item.description: Congress leader Jairam Ramesh stated that the National Clean Air Programme wrongly prioritizes PM10 particles. He emphasized that the finer PM2.5 pollutant poses the true danger to public health in the capital.

item.title: Salahuddin cooks meals for stray dogs and cats
item.description: Salahuddin prepares and feeds cooked food to hungry stray dogs and cats. The initiative aims to support stray animals in need of nourishment.

item.title: Bengaluru raids target Power TV head over sting video
item.description: Police searched the home and office of Power TV director Rakesh Shetty in Bengaluru. Shetty and former Congress member Kripa Alva face allegations of producing a fabricated sting video targeting Siddaramaiah.

item.title: Supreme Court denies relief to ex-minister Nehru in job scam
item.description: The Supreme Court rejected relief for former Tamil Nadu Minister Nehru in a cash-for-jobs investigation. The bench noted he may present his legal defenses during upcoming court proceedings.

item.title: Cyclone Murasu disrupts flights in Andhra Pradesh
item.description: Severe cyclonic storm Murasu led to the cancellation of 12 flights in Vijayawada and affected services in Visakhapatnam. The storm is forecasted to hit the south Andhra coast close to Ongole.

item.title: Ex-BASIC Bank chief flees to Canada after financial fraud
item.description: Former BASIC Bank chairman Sheikh Abdul Hye relocated to Canada amid accusations of severe financial corruption. Once a premier state institution, the bank deteriorated under his leadership while he denies wrongdoing.

item.title: Australia anticipates economic slowdown ahead of rate hike
item.description: Australia faces forecasts of a prolonged economic downturn as the central bank prepares for another interest rate increase on Tuesday. Pressures stem from falling property values and ongoing conflict in the Middle East.

item.title: Plane crash in southern Florida claims nine lives
item.description: A Learjet crashed into a residential area in southern Florida on Sunday, resulting in the deaths of all nine individuals on board. The incident occurred several miles away from Donald Trump's resort property.

item.title: AMU denies voting access to female students in union polls
item.description: Roughly 4,000 female attendees at Aligarh Muslim University's Women’s College cannot vote in the student union elections. This exclusion has sparked allegations of gender-based inequality regarding representation.

item.title: Alexander Zverev claims top men's tennis ranking amid lingering unease
item.description: Alexander Zverev currently holds the top position in men's tennis following strong performances this season. However, his rise to the number one spot continues to evoke mixed feelings within the sport.

item.title: Karnataka finalizes Bidadi township land acquisition
item.description: The Karnataka administration has released the final acquisition notice for the remaining two villages in the Bidadi township initiative. Protesting landowners have criticized the administration for advancing the scheme despite prior assurances to review it.
